scope: Appendix E Revit phasing, phase-filter, and Design Option controls

sources.title: View Standards – Instructions, Definitions, Workflows
source_findings: Views are expected to use consistent phase and phase-filter settings aligned to project requirements.
Phase and filter settings should be applied through view templates wherever possible.
Design Option visibility should normally inherit the project primary option; By View is reserved for cases where required.
The source explicitly leaves default primary options per discipline unresolved.

sources.title: Revit Standards and Workflow Guidelines
source_findings: View Phase and Phase Filter are to be set in templates and verified with representative existing/new/demolition conditions.
Phase-filter graphics should be checked against the intended legend and communication purpose.

sources.title: Category & Subcategory Graphics Standards and Guidelines
source_findings: Phase filters and Design Options can alter visibility and graphics and therefore must remain coordinated with governed View Standards.
